jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Product Management
jobs.description:
**Thank you for considering a career at Ensemble Health Partners India!**

  

Ensemble Health Partners \- The single solution for a frictionless revenue cycle with the purpose of redefining the possible in healthcare by empowering people to be the difference. Our India Office is an extension of Ensemble’s team and culture designed to augment and enhance our talent and skill base in Revenue Cycle Management in addition to our long\-standing presence in technology. Leveraging our platform of services, technology, business intelligence and analytics, our teams are creating and maintaining innovative products and systems to help our revenue cycle operators achieve the most efficient, ideal outcomes for our clients. Our teams are certified in revenue cycle best practices and are supporting end\-to\-end RCM operations. We are at the forefront of innovation using cutting\-edge technology to drive meaningful impact in the Revenue Cycle Management landscape. As a leading player in the industry, we offer an environment that fosters growth, creativity, and collaboration, where your expertise will be valued, and your contributions will make a difference.

**The Opportunity:**

**Position Overview:**


Product Manager is a key member of the Product Management vertical at Ensemble and manages the product development process within an organization. They research and determine clients needs, convert needs to consumable requirements, determine value and incorporate them into product roadmap. They are the primary contact for the offshore development teams and scrum teams for clarifying business requirements and unblocking them. They collaborate amongst scrum, engineering, data and product management teams to ensure the products meet specific objectives as outlined by stakeholders and clients. After product feature development, the Product Owner will conduct a final review and submit their approval before releasing the product into production.

 **Roles \& Responsibilities**

* Demonstrate understanding of RCM terms, industry standards, business processes, and Ensembles applications and information flow
* Understand, analyse, and document the business needs
* Build process flows for current and future state
* Breakdown business needs into features and stories and back them with diagrams and documentation
* Bring feature requirements to PM and Manager/Co\-manager for peer review
* Realize requirements, know the value and reasoning behind current prioritization
* Managing and creating forward looking product backlog
* Prioritizing the backlog items based on changing requirements
* Think comprehensively to align non\-functional (security, performance, etc) and reporting requirements to Functional features to ensure holistic development
* Work across different verticals ops\-engineering\-product\-analytics\-implementation to seek feature related feedback, understand and resolve dependencies
* Work with offshore engineering teams to clarify business requirements during offshore hours.
* Present requirements to the team during sprint planning, unblock the engineering teams and act as of proxy PM
* Work with the teams to build high level estimates, define timelines and respectively add features to roadmap
* Overseeing all stages of product creation including design and development, to understand any risk
* Monitoring and evaluating product development, to mitigate any risk
* Collaborate with engineering, product, and data teams to deliver updates
* Participating in grooming, scrum meetings and product sprints
* Perform feature acceptance
* Demonstrate deliverable to stakeholders

**Required Skills**

* Knowledge of Healthcare \- RCM (Revenue Cycle Management) or Insurance is a great plus
* Knowledge of product development architecture
* Experience working in an Agile environment using scrum methodologies
* Strong collaboration skills \- partner with others teams to solve problems, incorporate feedback and ensure smooth delivery
* Strong business analysis, documentation, and presentation skills
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Quick learner and ability to lead from the front
* Good to have Experience in multitenant enterprise cloud application, .Net, SQL
* Knowledge of Azure ADO, AHA, draw.io, Visio is a plus

 **Why Choose Ensemble India?**


People First, Last \+ Always


We believe in putting people at the heart of everything. Our culture is rooted in collaboration, growth and innovation—where your contributions are valued, your voice is heard and your potential is nurtured.

 **A Place to Thrive**


Whether you're just starting out or looking to grow your career, Ensemble India is a place where you can do your best work and be your best self. We offer structured career paths, paid professional certifications, tuition reimbursement and mentorship opportunities to help you advance.

 **Comprehensive Total Rewards**


We support the physical, emotional and financial well\-being of you and your family. Our Total Rewards package include:

* Healthcare coverage for associates and their immediate families including parents
* Paid time off plans
* Retirement benefits
* Recognition and wellness programs
* Market competitive pay rates

 **Inclusive Culture**


Our organization is deeply committed to fostering a positive environment and culture where we celebrate and reward merit and contribution and where every associate feels valued, included, and empowered to succeed.

 **Purpose\-Driven Impact**


We proudly partner with local communities through philanthropic initiatives—from school supply drives to health awareness campaigns—because giving back is part of who we are.

  

Ensemble Health Partners is an **equal employment opportunity employer**. jobs.title: UX Research Manager
jobs.description:
**ACB đang tìm kiếm User Experience Research Manager để giúp chúng tôi hiểu khách hàng sâu sắc hơn**
====================================================================================================



Chuyển đổi số trong ngân hàng thường được nhìn nhận qua những ứng dụng mới, những công nghệ mới hay những quy trình được tự động hóa.



Nhưng phía sau mỗi trải nghiệm khách hàng xuất sắc luôn có một yếu tố quan trọng hơn: sự thấu hiểu.



Thấu hiểu khách hàng thực sự đang gặp khó khăn gì.



Thấu hiểu điều gì thúc đẩy họ đưa ra quyết định.



Và thấu hiểu đâu là những trải nghiệm tạo ra giá trị khác biệt.



Tại ACB, chúng tôi đang bước vào một giai đoạn chuyển đổi mới với mục tiêu xây dựng những trải nghiệm đơn giản hơn, cá nhân hóa hơn và lấy khách hàng làm trung tâm trên toàn bộ hệ sinh thái dịch vụ tài chính.



Để hiện thực hóa mục tiêu đó, chúng tôi đang tìm kiếm một **User Experience Research Manager** thuộc Văn phòng Quản lý Chuyển đổi, người sẽ đóng vai trò dẫn dắt năng lực nghiên cứu trải nghiệm khách hàng và chuyển hóa những hiểu biết về khách hàng thành các quyết định thiết kế, sản phẩm và chuyển đổi của ngân hàng.


### **Vai trò này sẽ tạo ra tác động gì?**



Bạn sẽ là người dẫn dắt các hoạt động nghiên cứu hành vi, nhu cầu và cảm nhận của khách hàng thông qua các phương pháp nghiên cứu định tính và định lượng, từ đó cung cấp những insight có giá trị cho việc thiết kế sản phẩm, cải tiến dịch vụ và tối ưu hóa hành trình trải nghiệm khách hàng.


Những nghiên cứu của bạn sẽ góp phần định hướng cho các sáng kiến chiến lược như:


* Số hóa hành trình tín dụng dành cho khách hàng cá nhân.
* Số hóa hành trình phi tín dụng dành cho khách hàng cá nhân.
* Phát triển các giải pháp Wealth Management và Quản lý Gia sản.
* Thiết kế và cải tiến các hành trình khách hàng trên toàn hệ thống.
* Xây dựng văn hóa ra quyết định dựa trên dữ liệu và tiếng nói khách hàng.


Đây không phải là vị trí nghiên cứu thuần túy.



Chúng tôi tìm kiếm người có khả năng kết nối giữa nghiên cứu, chiến lược kinh doanh, trải nghiệm khách hàng và thực thi chuyển đổi.



Người có thể biến dữ liệu thành insight.



Biến insight thành hành động.



Và biến hành động thành những trải nghiệm tốt hơn cho hàng triệu khách hàng.


### **Chúng tôi tìm kiếm ai?**



Ứng viên lý tưởng sẽ sở hữu:


* Tối thiểu 7 năm kinh nghiệm trong nghiên cứu trải nghiệm khách hàng, UX Research, Customer Insight, Product Research hoặc các lĩnh vực liên quan.
* Tối thiểu 3 năm kinh nghiệm dẫn dắt các chương trình nghiên cứu hoặc các dự án sản phẩm có quy mô lớn và phức tạp.
* Kinh nghiệm trong các lĩnh vực **ngân hàng, tài chính, bảo hiểm, fintech hoặc các dịch vụ tài chính**.
* Hiểu biết vững chắc về các phương pháp nghiên cứu định tính, định lượng, usability testing, persona, customer journey mapping và các công cụ phân tích dữ liệu nghiên cứu.
* Khả năng kể chuyện bằng dữ liệu, trình bày insight một cách trực quan, thuyết phục và tạo ảnh hưởng đến các bên liên quan.
* Kinh nghiệm làm việc đa chức năng với Business, Product, Design, Technology và các đơn vị vận hành để đưa kết quả nghiên cứu vào ứng dụng thực tế.

### **Vì sao nên cân nhắc cơ hội này?**



Tại ACB, bạn sẽ không chỉ thực hiện các nghiên cứu riêng lẻ.



Bạn sẽ góp phần xây dựng năng lực nghiên cứu trải nghiệm khách hàng cho một trong những chương trình chuyển đổi quan trọng nhất của ngân hàng.



Bạn sẽ được tiếp cận những bài toán phức tạp về ngân hàng bán lẻ, trải nghiệm số, hành vi khách hàng, quản lý gia sản và chuyển đổi doanh nghiệp.



Quan trọng hơn, những insight được tạo ra từ công việc của bạn sẽ ảnh hưởng trực tiếp đến cách ACB thiết kế sản phẩm, xây dựng hành trình khách hàng và phục vụ hàng triệu người dùng trong tương lai.



Nếu bạn tin rằng mọi quyết định thiết kế tốt đều bắt đầu từ sự thấu hiểu khách hàng, và mong muốn tạo ra tác động ở quy mô lớn trong ngành dịch vụ tài chính, chúng tôi mong được kết nối với bạn.


**Ứng tuyển hoặc liên hệ trực tiếp để trao đổi thêm về cơ hội tại ACB.**



\#ACB \#CustomerExperience \#UXResearch \#CustomerInsight \#DigitalTransformation \#RetailBanking \#WealthManagement \#FinancialServices \#Insurance \#BankingCareer \#Hiring \#TransformationOffice \#CustomerJourneyManagement

jobs.title: UX Design Manager
jobs.description:
**ACB đang tìm kiếm User Experience Design Manager để kiến tạo tương lai trải nghiệm khách hàng**
=================================================================================================



Ngành tài chính đang thay đổi rất nhanh. Khi sản phẩm, lãi suất hay công nghệ ngày càng trở nên dễ sao chép, trải nghiệm khách hàng đang trở thành lợi thế cạnh tranh bền vững nhất.



Tại ACB, chúng tôi đang thực hiện một hành trình chuyển đổi toàn diện với mục tiêu xây dựng những trải nghiệm đơn giản hơn, thông minh hơn và lấy khách hàng làm trung tâm trên toàn bộ vòng đời sử dụng dịch vụ.



Đó không chỉ là hành trình số hóa.



Đó là hành trình thiết kế lại cách khách hàng tương tác với ngân hàng, từ những giao dịch thường ngày, các nhu cầu tín dụng, cho đến những giải pháp quản lý tài sản và gia sản trong tương lai.



Để hiện thực hóa tầm nhìn đó, ACB đang tìm kiếm **User Experience Design Manager** thuộc Văn phòng Quản lý Chuyển đổi, người sẽ đóng vai trò quan trọng trong việc thiết kế và nâng tầm trải nghiệm khách hàng trên các nền tảng số của ngân hàng.


### **Vai trò này sẽ tham gia vào những sáng kiến nào?**



Bạn sẽ đồng hành cùng các chương trình chuyển đổi chiến lược của ngân hàng như:


* Số hóa hành trình tín dụng dành cho khách hàng cá nhân.
* Số hóa hành trình phi tín dụng dành cho khách hàng cá nhân.
* Xây dựng và phát triển các giải pháp Wealth Management và Quản lý Gia sản thông qua hợp tác chiến lược với các đối tác trong hệ sinh thái.
* Thiết kế và tối ưu các hành trình khách hàng xuyên suốt trên các kênh số.

### **Chúng tôi tìm kiếm ai?**



Đây không phải là vị trí UX chỉ tập trung vào giao diện.



Chúng tôi tìm kiếm những người có khả năng nhìn nhận trải nghiệm khách hàng dưới góc độ kinh doanh, vận hành và công nghệ.



Những ứng viên phù hợp thường sở hữu:


* Tối thiểu 7 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực thiết kế trải nghiệm người dùng cho các sản phẩm số quy mô lớn.
* Tối thiểu 3 năm kinh nghiệm dẫn dắt hoặc chịu trách nhiệm chính cho các chương trình chuyển đổi hoặc phát triển sản phẩm phức tạp.
* Kinh nghiệm làm việc trong các tổ chức thuộc lĩnh vực **ngân hàng, tài chính, bảo hiểm hoặc dịch vụ tài chính**.
* Khả năng nghiên cứu hành vi khách hàng, thiết kế user flow, wireframe, prototype và cải tiến trải nghiệm dựa trên dữ liệu thực tế.
* Kinh nghiệm phối hợp đa chức năng với Business, Product Owner, Technology, Data và các bên liên quan để đưa thiết kế vào triển khai thực tế.

### **Vì sao đây là cơ hội đáng cân nhắc?**



Tại ACB, bạn không chỉ tham gia cải tiến một màn hình hay một tính năng.



Bạn sẽ góp phần định hình các hành trình phục vụ hàng triệu khách hàng trong một trong những chương trình chuyển đổi quy mô lớn của ngân hàng.



Bạn sẽ được làm việc với các bài toán thực tế về trải nghiệm khách hàng, chuyển đổi số, ngân hàng bán lẻ và quản lý gia sản. Đồng thời, bạn có cơ hội tạo ra những thay đổi có tác động trực tiếp tới tăng trưởng kinh doanh và sự hài lòng của khách hàng trên toàn hệ thống.



Nếu bạn tin rằng trải nghiệm khách hàng chính là nơi giao thoa giữa chiến lược, công nghệ và đổi mới, và mong muốn để lại dấu ấn trong hành trình chuyển đổi của một ngân hàng hàng đầu Việt Nam, chúng tôi rất mong được kết nối.

jobs.title: Senior Product Owner II
jobs.description:
Job Description:
**Role Summary**
The Product Owner for IA Services \& Advisory is responsible for translating business strategy and customer needs into clear, actionable requirements that can be effectively delivered by Agile R\&D teams. Acting as the primary interface between **Product Management** and **engineering**, the Product Owner ensures that service offers deliver measurable business value while meeting technical, quality, and time‑to‑market expectations.
Operating within an Agile framework, the Product Owner owns and prioritizes the product backlog, drives sprint and release readiness, and ensures alignment between the Services vision and execution. This role combines customer\-centric thinking, strong Agile leadership, and cross‑functional collaboration to support the end‑to‑end lifecycle of IA Services offers.**Key Responsibilities****Agile Product Ownership \& Delivery*** Act as **Product Owner for one or more Scrum teams**, working closely with the SCRUM Master to ensure Agile ceremonies, practices, and principles are effectively applied.
* Own, maintain, and prioritize the **product backlog**, ensuring a continuous flow of well‑defined, ready‑for‑development user stories.
* Lead **backlog refinement, sprint planning, iteration reviews, and release planning**, ensuring alignment with sprint and release goals.
* Ensure development teams have a clear understanding of **acceptance criteria, priorities, and expected outcomes**.
* Actively identify, escalate, and support the resolution of impediments that may impact sprint or release commitments.

**Bridge Between Business and Technology*** Partner closely with **Product Managers** to translate market needs, customer requirements, and service strategy into clear epics, features, and user stories.
* Ensure consistent alignment between **business value, customer outcomes, and technical feasibility**.
* Serve as the primary point of clarification for R\&D teams regarding functional intent, priorities, and scope trade‑offs.
* Balance short‑term delivery needs with long‑term architectural and service sustainability considerations.

**Value, Strategy \& Governance*** Assess and articulate **business value, ROI, and risk**, using these insights to drive prioritization decisions.
* Provide input into the **product vision, roadmap, and release strategy** for IA Services offers.
* Ensure delivered features and services align with overall **Services \& Advisory business objectives**.
* Support lifecycle management activities including part numbers, licensing models, purchase orders, and service packaging where applicable.

**Stakeholder Engagement \& Enablement*** Collaborate effectively with stakeholders across **Services, R\&D, Sales, Marketing, Delivery, and Support**.
* Communicate progress, dependencies, and trade‑offs clearly to both technical and non‑technical audiences.
* Contribute to **training, enablement, and internal/external communication** related to service offers and new capabilities.
* Act as a **product thought leader** for the assigned service area, promoting best practices and continuous improvement.


(External) English Qualifications:
**Experience*** Proven experience as a **Product Owner** within an Agile/SCRUM environment, preferably in services, industrial, or technology‑driven portfolios.
* Demonstrated ability to work at the intersection of **business strategy and technical delivery**.
* Experience delivering solutions involving **cloud and edge computing, artificial intelligence, data, and/or hardware‑enabled services**.

**Education*** Degree in **Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems**, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 12\+Years of overall expeirence

**Skills \& Competencies*** Deep understanding of **Agile and SCRUM principles**, practices, and tooling.
* Strong ability to break down complex business needs into **clear, actionable requirements**.
* Excellent **communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management** skills.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to assess value, risk, and dependencies.
* Highly organized, detail‑oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
* Collaborative, customer‑focused, and comfortable influencing without direct authority.
* Experience in DevOps, Jira, TFS \- Requirement creation and monitoring Tools \& Planning tools \- IObeya, Aha

**Success Factors*** Consistent delivery of high‑value service capabilities aligned with business strategy
* Well‑maintained, prioritized, and transparent product backlog
* Strong trust and collaboration between Product Management, R\&D, and Services teams
* High engagement and effectiveness of Agile teams
* Positive feedback from internal stakeholders and customers

The DSP program is the backbone of Amazon's last\-mile delivery network, operating in 22 countries with over 4,400 DSPs and 390,000\+ Delivery Associates.
   

  

 This role is responsible for customer experiences with considerable complexity, managing a unified data platform that serves as the single source of truth for associate information. This includes ownership of multiple concurrent product workstreams — DSP DA onboarding/off\-boarding workflow, DSP onboarding/off\-boarding experience, employment classification models, qualifications management, and DA data/metadata services — each requiring distinct technical approaches and stakeholder alignment. The Sr. Product Manager\-Tech is responsible for driving strategic goals that span multi\-million dollar cost savings, DSP satisfaction (CSAT), and DA sentiment — influencing the DA experience from the very first interaction with Amazon's systems. You will own the financial entitlement for your product area and be accountable for measurable improvements in onboarding speed, compliance automation, and operational efficiency for DSPs worldwide.
   

  

 We are in the early stages of a multi\-year initiative to overhaul much of the DA lifecycle experience from the ground up. This is a rare opportunity to invent and simplify at scale — redesigning foundational systems and workflows that touch hundreds of thousands of drivers globally. The role comes with significant investment backing and outsized influence in shaping what the next\-generation experience looks like.
   

  

 This is a global role requiring cross\-regional coordination across all regions where the DSP program is established or will be established, each with distinct compliance requirements, legal frameworks, hiring models, and payment structures. The role requires distinguishing between one\-way and two\-way door decisions to drive rapid experimentation where possible while ensuring appropriate rigor for irreversible choices. The Sr. Product Manager\-Tech serves as Voice of the Customer by generalizing requirements from diverse DSP DA personas across regions and use cases — working backward from their needs to reduce friction and time spent in onboarding and offboarding phases. Through direct engagement with DSPs, analysis of support tickets, and monitoring of operational health post\-launch, the Sr. Product Manager\-Tech gains insight that distinguishes between surface\-level requests and underlying problems that truly matter. The Sr. Product Manager\-Tech regularly drives product discussions with senior managers and Directors, producing clear documentation and contributing to OP1/OP2 planning cycles.
   

  

 We are seeking a PM with expertise and high judgment to determine the right goals, design long\-term solutions, and take the lead on initiatives independently while seeking direction when needed. This role operates in a space where problems, opportunities, and strategy are not always clearly defined, and the right candidate will thrive in that ambiguity.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Leading the build\-out of new external facing applications, products, features and tools.
* Owning the translation of business intent, customer needs, and/or technical direction into clear, concise, well\-documented business requirements or product backlog for one or more complex applications (or a product family) spanning one or more technical domains.

* Communicate and collaborate cross\-functionally across multiple teams in operations, technology and planning to define strategic roadmaps while keeping the impact of the solution to all stakeholders in mind
* Creating and implementing data driven improvements to Amazon's transportation network
* Monitoring KPI’s to analyze their drivers and determine the level of investment needed

 The team consists of engineers, product managers, and program managers. These functions roll up into a shared VP with a shared goal of delivering the most efficient experience for our transportation partners.

jobs.description:
Leads the strategic vision and roadmap for a digital product, demonstrating a understanding of the digital product(s) and associated business areas. Digital products often have divisional implications.
   

  

**About Vanguard**
 Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
   

  

******Vanguard’s India Office******
 Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud\-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world\-class experience for our clients.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 This role leads the strategic vision and roadmap for a digital product, demonstrating an understanding of the digital product(s) and associated business areas. Digital products often have divisional implications. This role also integrates market trends and consumer insights to drive product innovation and inform future enhancements.
   

  

**Responsibilites**
* Provides digital product management services on a digital product, applying functional expertise to improve digital product results.
* Collaborates with small cross\-functional teams to demonstrate best practices that drive significant change to the client experience.
* Coaches digital product teams towards best practices and learnings. Ensures delivery of messaging, communication, and customer outreach as necessary.
* Partners with stakeholders to resolve production and implementation issues in a timely manner, and supports/drives escalations where required to enable rapid delivery.
* Leads the planning, development and implementation of a new digital product. Defines and analyzes markets, developing detailed product features and requirements, and developing implementation plans.
* Employs a variety of qualitative and quantitative analysis techniques to continually improve the user experience.
* Participates in and provides recommendations for ongoing business planning and departmental prioritization activities.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Manages the entire product lifecycle from planning to execution, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
* Researches market conditions and identifies emerging consumer trends to guide product innovation and enhancement opportunities.
* Collaborates with cross\-functional teams to define and oversee the development of product features and functionality.
* Prepares product documentation and supports marketing and sales with product knowledge and technical expertise.
* Leverages customer and market feedback to assess product performance and inform future roadmap decisions.


**Qualifications And Skills**
* Minimum 5 years of product management or related work experience; two years of project management preferred. Experience in financial services or function\-specific domains is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc./BBA) in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field is required.
* Good to have skills in digital product lifecycle management, stakeholder collaboration, customer journey optimization, market and trend analysis, and cross\-functional coordination.
* Familiarity with product development tools and agile methodologies is desirable.
* Platform skills in digital technologies, data analytics tools, and customer engagement platforms are beneficial.
* Strong written and verbal communication, problem\-solving, time management, and analytical skills are essential.
* Certifications such as Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, or Pragmatic Product Management are preferred.


******Location******
 This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard’s India office. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
   

  

******Our mission******
 Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
   

  

******Our commitment to you******
 Vanguard takes the same long\-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
   

  

******Financial wellness******
 We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
   

  

******Physical wellness******
 We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
   

  

******Personal wellness******
 We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
   

  

******How we work******
 Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in\-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission\-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long\-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

 Cornerstone's Workforce AI platform is redefining how the world's largest organizations understand their people — building a skills\-first intelligence layer that connects workforce data, market signal, and a growing set of AI\-powered and agentic experiences.
   

  

 We're hiring a Product Manager in Hyderabad to drive execution across the Workforce Intelligence platform, working hand\-in\-hand with our engineering teams. This role sits close to the build: you'll own delivery of platform capabilities from spec through release, ensure quality across the release pipeline, and serve as the connective tissue between global product strategy and day\-to\-day engineering execution.
   

  

 This is a role for a PM who loves shipping — someone who is technical enough to earn engineering's trust, rigorous enough to own release quality, and customer\-minded enough to keep every sprint tied to real enterprise outcomes.

 Partner daily with engineering teams to translate product strategy into well\-scoped, buildable increments
   

  

 Drive the release process for your workstreams — release notes, gating criteria, risk identification, and cross\-team dependency management
   

  

 Own API and headless access capabilities, including agent tooling and developer\-facing experiences that let customers and partners build on the platform

 Use AI\-assisted workflows as a core part of how you work — we build with AI, not just for it
   

  

**You Have Got What It Takes If You Have**
 5\+ years of product management experience, ideally with enterprise SaaS or platform products — able to resolve a wide range of issues of diverse scope with good judgment in selecting methods and approaches
   

  

 Strong technical fluency — you can read an API contract, discuss data models with engineers, and translate system architecture tradeoffs to drive intended business outcomes
   

  

 Proven track record of shipping: you've owned releases, managed dependencies, and driven quality across a delivery pipeline
   

  

 Experience with enterprise platform products; familiarity with AI\-powered or LLM\-based features is a strong plus
   

  

 Crisp written communication — specs and status updates that engineers, executives, and customers can all act on
   

  

 Comfort operating across time zones with globally distributed product and engineering leadership
   

  

 Ownership mindset: you find gaps before they become escalations and close them without being asked
   

  

 Nice to Have
   

  

 Experience with HR tech, talent intelligence, skills platforms, or people analytics
   

  

 Familiarity with developer platforms: APIs, SDKs, webhooks, or agent/tool protocols
   

  

 Exposure to compliance\-driven product work (SOC 2, data privacy, EU AI Act)
   

  

 Hands\-on experience prototyping with AI coding tools
   

  

**Why This Role**
 You'll join a small, senior team building the AI backbone of a market\-leading platform, with exposure to global product leadership and enterprise customers — and you'll help define how AI\-native product teams operate.
   

  

 Cornerstone is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team

 Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager — Growth & Revenue
jobs.description:
We're hiring:
 




  





 Senior Product Manager — Growth \& Revenue —
 
 1acre.in
 
  






 Land is the most opaque market in India. People still get burned buying a plot because the basic information — is it verified, who owns it, what's the master plan, can I even reach the seller — is scattered or hidden.
 




  






 We're fixing that. 1acre is India's verified land \& plot marketplace: 16,000\+ verified lands and plots on one live map, real sellers you can contact directly, no spam. Mission is simple — solve the information problem in land. Verify it, make it instantly discoverable, help people transact at scale. Then take it global.
 




  






 The verification problem is largely solved. The next one is commercial: get found, get people to act, get paid. We're looking for a Senior PM to own that end to end — with AI as a force multiplier at every step.
 




  





  





**WHAT YOU'LL OWN** 




  





**Organic SEO growth** 



* Land search is high\-intent and geographically fragmented — "agriculture land for sale in Sangareddy," "Guntur master plan," "HMDA layout survey number." Thousands of queries, real buyers behind each one.
* You own the page architecture, programmatic templates, internal linking, schema, indexation — and the content quality that keeps rankings once you win them.
* Measured on non\-brand organic sessions and organic\-sourced contacts. Not impressions.



  





**Engagement \& conversion** 



* Traffic that lands and leaves is a cost.
* You own the funnel from landing to contact: map and listing UX, filter comprehension, search\-intent matching, trust signals, and the WhatsApp handoff.
* WhatsApp is our primary conversion channel by design, not by accident.
* You should have a view on how to make it convert harder.



  





**Monetization** 



* Subscriptions, premium map layers, and the developer dashboard.
* Determine what's worth paying for, pricing, paywall placement, and how value is demonstrated prior to purchase.
* Own revenue and conversion\-to\-paid directly as key metric targets.



  





**Data intelligence \& API** 





 • Our layer data — survey numbers, master plans, metro, air funnels, cadastral, heritage — is the most defensible thing we have, and today only our own product consumes it. 
 





 • There is a plausible business selling it to developers, lenders, brokerages, infra consultants. 
 




  






 You own finding out whether that's real: packaging, pricing, the API surface, the first design partners. The founder runs early sales conversations with you. 
 




  






 • Converting demand signals into a product — or telling us clearly there isn't one — are both wins.
 




  





**Quality, end to end** 





 • Turn problems into specs crisp enough that both engineers and AI agents can build from them with zero guesswork. 
 





 • Partner with design (Figma) from idea to pixel — flows, edge cases, empty and error states, and the copy that goes with them. 
 





 • Own the test plan across buyer, seller, and developer journeys. Verify on real devices. Confirm the analytics events actually fire. Sign off before anything launches.
 




  





  





**HOW WE WORK** 




  





**We ship, then we decide.** 

 Something small in front of real users in two weeks beats two months of research. Kill rate is expected to be high and that's fine — killing your own work fast is a skill we value, not a failure we tolerate.
 




  






 • Weekly ship cadence. Cut scope rather than slip dates.
 





 • Every launch carries a metric and a decision date before it goes out. 
 





 • You instrument what you ship. Define the Mixpanel events yourself, build the funnel, read it honestly. 
 





 • If you need three rounds of validation before committing to a bet, you'll find this frustrating.
 




  





**YOU'RE A FIT IF YOU** 




  




* Have 4–8 years shipping products, with at least 2 owning growth, SEO, or monetization on a consumer or marketplace product.
* Have moved a number and can prove it — organic traffic, conversion rate, ARPU, paid conversion. Pick one and walk us through what you actually did.
* Know SEO for real. Not "managed an agency" — you understand crawl budget, programmatic page quality, cannibalization, and why most programmatic SEO decays.
* Are genuinely AI\-native — you use LLMs every day to spec, prototype, test, and analyze, and you have real opinions about where they help and where they don't.
* Write with precision. A spec from you leaves nothing ambiguous.
* Read your own data. SQL or a BI tool, funnels, cohorts, Mixpanel or equivalent. You don't wait for an analyst to tell you what happened.
* Treat QA as your job, not someone else's — it's not "done" until you've tried to break it.
* Know (or will rapidly learn) the Indian land context — survey numbers, plots vs lands, cents/gaj, master plans, district\-level nuance.
* Will go to the field. Some of this product cannot be understood from a desk in Hyderabad.
* Sweat the details AND move fast. Both, not one.



  





**BONUS POINTS** 




  




* Marketplaces, classifieds, proptech, or fintech background.
* Have productized or sold data or an API before, even at a small scale.
* Maps/GIS — Mapbox, QGIS, cadastral or survey records.
* Telugu, or another South Indian language, for user conversations.
* Early\-startup experience. You know what the first 20 people have to be like.
* Hands\-on with Figma, Linear/Jira, Mixpanel/Google Analytics, Search Console.



  





**WHY 1ACRE** 




  




* A real problem at real scale — every honest fix here protects someone's life savings.
* AI\-first for real — we ship with modern AI tooling, we don't just talk about it.
* Small team, high ownership, fast decisions. Your work goes live, not into a backlog.
* You own revenue\-facing surfaces from day one, reporting directly to the founder. No layers.

Wolt and Roo operate under the DoorDash umbrella, and Customer Support sits at the intersection of brand experience, unit economics and long\-term growth. This role owns the strategy on:

* How do we architect frontline service design to be AI\-ready as frontline tooling evolves, deliver best\-in\-class customer experience, and remain cost\-efficient?
* How do we manage our workforce with precision, eliminating waste, consolidating overlapping structures, and continuously improving headcount efficiency through automation and org redesign?


This is a permanent leadership role. The person in this seat will own network strategy, service design and workforce management as a continuous discipline, embedding deeply into Wolt, Roo and DoorDash technology stacks, building and refreshing the financial and operational case for change, and evolving the execution roadmap as the business, technology and market shift.

* Own the demand and supply planning, and scheduling for the network, partnering deeply with upstream business owners and defect elimination to enable forecasting accuracy.
* Own ongoing assessment of how service is structured and delivered at the frontline across both brands.

jobs.description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**
 We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
   

  

 We use cutting\-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience.
 **Want to be part of it?**
**Purpose of the Role**
 The Product Owner owns the outcomes of a customer\-facing product area: things dealers and their staff use every day, like booking, workshop scheduling, or repair order management. You'll work closely with the Product Manager to turn strategic direction into a prioritised backlog, and with an agile engineering team to get customer\-focused improvements shipped quickly.
   

  

 This is a fast\-moving, iteration\-heavy role. You'll be close to real user feedback and expected to adjust the backlog based on what you learn, not just what was planned.
   

  

 AI tooling is a growing and permanent part of how our Product and Engineering teams work, and this role is evolving with it. We expect Product Owners to grow into hands\-on AI\-building over time. This is a deliberate direction for the role, not a distant possibility, and we're looking for people who are genuinely ready and willing to make that journey, even if they're not there yet.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own and prioritise the development team backlog to ensure high\-value delivery
* Write, refine, and prioritise epics and user stories with clear acceptance criteria
* Act as the voice of the customer, representing dealer and end\-user needs in every backlog decision
* Collaborate with the development team during Iteration Planning, stand\-ups, and reviews
* Accept completed user stories against the Definition of Done
* Work with the Product Manager to keep the team backlog aligned to the wider product roadmap
* Monitor product usage and performance metrics, and use them to inform prioritisation
* Translate product strategy into concrete, sequenced pieces of work


**Working with AI: where this role is going**
* Use AI tools (e.g. Claude) to support day\-to\-day product work now: drafting specs, exploring data, speeding up research and analysis
* Grow into hands\-on use of AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code) to prototype and validate ideas yourself, with structured training and time provided to get there
* Apply judgement on where AI\-assisted output needs human review
* Understand that this capability will become a core, evaluated part of the role over time, not an optional extra


**Skills, Know\-how And Experience**
**Must have**
* Solid understanding of Agile principles and the Product Owner role within Scaled Agile
* Proven ability to write clear, concise epics and user stories
* Strong communication skills, comfortable representing the customer view to engineering and to the Product Manager
* Ability to read data and use it to make prioritisation calls
* Familiarity with customer\-centric product development
* Comfortable using AI tools day\-to\-day to support product work (e.g. research, writing, analysis), plus a clear, genuine willingness to grow into hands\-on AI\-building (e.g. Claude Code) as this becomes a core part of the role. This is where the Product Owner role at Keyloop is deliberately heading. Candidates should be ready to commit to that development path, even if not yet hands\-on today


**Preferred**
* Experience in a Scaled Agile environment (e.g. Scrum@Scale, SAFe)
* Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, or similar tools
* Relevant certifications (e.g. CSPO, SAFe POPM)
* Experience in automotive, dealer software, or similar B2B SaaS domains
* Understanding of automotive aftersales processes (e.g. service booking, workshop operations, repair order lifecycle)


 Existing hands\-on experience using AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code) to build or prototype software
   

  

**Development pathway**
 Growing into hands\-on AI\-building is an expected part of every Product Owner's development here. This isn't an exception process, it's the plan for everyone. We'll invest in structured training and dedicated time to help you get there. What matters on day one is genuine readiness and willingness to make that journey, not that you've already arrived.
   

  

**Why join us?**
 We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space \- and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game\-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.
   

  

**An inclusive environment to thrive**
 We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles \- not just on key days, but every day.
   

  

**Be rewarded for your efforts**
 We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.

An integral part of our companys’ IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
   

  

 A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well\-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.

jobs.description:
**About the Role**



We build agentic AI and intelligent automation solutions for enterprise clients across construction, finance, procurement, healthcare and real estate. This role sits at the front of delivery: you will run discovery with client business teams, translate messy real\-world processes into clear requirements, and stay with the solution through build, UAT and go\-live.



This is not a documentation\-only role. You are expected to understand how RPA bots and AI agents actually work, challenge scope, and design processes that automation can realistically deliver.



**What You’ll Do**


* Lead requirement gathering workshops with client stakeholders — process owners, finance, procurement, IT and operations.
* Map as\-is processes, identify automation candidates, and design to\-be process flows with clear human\-in\-the\-loop control points.
* Author BRDs, functional specifications, user stories, process maps and acceptance criteria that developers can build from without guesswork.
* Build the business case: baseline effort, volumes, error rates, cycle times, and projected ROI for each use case.
* Define agent scope — what the agent decides autonomously, what it recommends, and where a human must approve.
* Work with solution architects and developers to validate feasibility across RPA platforms, LLM\-based agents, and ERP/system integrations.
* Own UAT: build test scenarios, coordinate client testing, track defects to closure.
* Support change management — SOP updates, user training material, and adoption tracking post go\-live.
* Manage scope and expectations across multiple concurrent client engagements.


**Must\-Have Qualifications**


* **Minimum 4 years** as a Business Analyst, with at least 2 years on RPA and/or AI/agentic AI delivery projects.
* Demonstrable end\-to\-end delivery experience — you have taken at least two automation or AI use cases from discovery through to production.
* Strong process analysis skills: process mapping (BPMN or equivalent), gap analysis, exception handling design.
* Proven BRD/FRD/user story authoring ability — please be prepared to walk us through a document you have written.
* Excellent client\-facing communication; comfortable running workshops with senior stakeholders and pushing back when a request is not feasible.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Finance or a related field.


**Relevant Technologies (hands\-on or working exposure)**


**RPA \& low\-code automation**


* UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Blue Prism, or Power Automate (Desktop \& Cloud)
* Microsoft Power Platform — Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse


**Agentic AI \& LLM tooling**


* Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, LangChain / LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent agent frameworks
* RAG architectures, prompt design, vector stores, document intelligence / OCR (Azure Document Intelligence, ABBYY)
* Understanding of agent evaluation, guardrails, hallucination risk and audit/traceability requirements


**Enterprise systems \& data**


* ERP exposure — Oracle Fusion, SAP, Dynamics 365, or a construction/finance ERP
* Familiarity with APIs and integration patterns (REST, webhooks); ability to read a Swagger/Postman collection
* SQL for data validation and volume analysis
* Documentation \& delivery tooling — Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Visio / Lucid / draw.io
* Domain depth in procurement, finance/AP, HSE, contracts, or inventory processes.


**Nice to Have**


* Experience delivering to UAE / GCC clients and comfort working to Gulf business hours where an engagement requires it.
* Certification in UiPath BA, Microsoft PL\-600 / AI\-102, CBAP, or Agile/Scrum.
* Experience sizing and pricing automation opportunities as part of a proposal or pre\-sales cycle.

jobs.title: Specialist - Business Analysis
jobs.description:
**Role Description**
**Role Name: Business Analyst – Data Specialization**
**Experience Range** 
 : 5–9 Years
   

  

**Location** 
 : Pan India
   

  

**Working Hours** 
 : Usually 12:30 PM to 8:30 PM IST
   

  

**Must\-Have Skills**
 Candidates must meet or exceed the required skills and experience outlined below.
   

  

 Business Analyst – Data Specialization
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Business Analyst – Data Specialization serves as the critical link between business needs, data quality, and technical execution. This role requires a deep understanding of business objectives to drive system improvements while acting as a hands\-on guardian of data health. The primary focus is on analyzing operational resources, independently validating data through SQL, and translating complex data quality challenges into clear narratives for business stakeholders.
   

  

 This role will be part of a product team specializing in labor market insights and research to support clients’ staffing needs.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Strategic Analysis and Solution Definition


 Business Problem \& Data Quality Analysis
   

  

* Understand complex business objectives and proactively identify data quality issues.
* Independently execute advanced SQL queries in BigQuery to diagnose anomalies and validate logic without dependency on Data Engineers.


 Alternative Solutions
   

  

* Identify, analyze, and perform feasibility studies on functionalities requiring granular solutions or improvements to existing functionalities.
* Assess factors such as the impact of data volume on performance.


 Data Mapping \& Business Logic
   

  

* Review functional requirements and create mappings between business requirements and data fields.
* Leverage the full potential of underlying data, such as mapping data to heatmaps based on defined distance radii.
* Requirements Elicitation and Documentation


 Functional Documentation
   

  

* Analyze existing business requirements, data flows, and processes.
* Document functionalities and identify current data gaps.


 Logic Definition for Advanced Metrics
   

  

* Define and document calculation logic for critical business metrics, including Scarcity, Job Vacancy Rate, Market Tightness, and Time\-to\-Fill/Cost\-per\-Hire.


 Data Mapping for Data Layers
   

  

* Create detailed mapping specifications to support the accurate creation of bronze, silver, and gold data layers.


 User Story Development
   

  

* Translate complex business needs into clear, actionable functional and non\-functional requirements.
* Document requirements as Epics and detailed User Stories with robust acceptance criteria.
* Collaboration and Alignment


 Data Quality Management
   

  

* Define data quality standards and establish key data health KPIs, including Data Completeness Score, Data Accuracy Rate, and Data Freshness.


 Root Cause Prevention
   

  

* Trace data anomalies to their source, including ATS and market inputs.
* Develop requirements to prevent data corruption at the point of entry.


 Stakeholder Partnership \& Education
   

  

* Collaborate closely with Product Owners and global markets.
* Explain complex data quality issues to business stakeholders in non\-technical terms and drive market\-level improvements.


**Qualifications**
 Candidates must meet or exceed the following required skills and experience:
   

  

 Data Specialization
   

  

* Hands\-on experience as a Business Analyst with a data specialization, demonstrating strong analytical and documentation skills.


 Advanced SQL Proficiency
   

  

* Demonstrated expertise in writing complex queries in BigQuery to independently validate data, debug issues, and support decision\-making without technical assistance.


 Cross\-Functional Collaboration
   

  

* Proven ability to work with technical and non\-technical teams to analyze complex data\-driven business problems and recommend actionable solutions.


 Data Workflow Optimization
   

  

* Experience designing and optimizing data workflows and data management processes using modeling or mapping tools.


 Agile Documentation
   

  

* Strong experience writing Epics and User Stories, including acceptance criteria, to communicate functional and non\-functional requirements effectively.


 Data Documentation
   

  

* Experience creating and maintaining data\-related documentation, including data dictionaries, BRDs, and data mapping specifications.


**Preferred Requirements**
 The following skills and experience are preferred:
   

  

 GCP Experience
   

  

* Working experience with GCP resources, particularly BigQuery, including hands\-on querying.


**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree (3–4 years) in Computer Science, Business Analytics, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field. Equivalent experience may be substituted.


 Talent Intelligence Domain
   

  

* Understanding of skills ontologies, matching logic, recruitment KPIs (e.g., Match Quality), and the operational distinctions between RPO/MSP and Staffing models.


**Skills**
**Mandatory Skills : BFS \- Data Analysis**

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Developer
jobs.description:
**About this Role**

*We're looking for a Founding Full Stack Engineer to help build and scale Valerie's multi\-tenant platform for e\-commerce brands. You'll work across the entire product stack — from React interfaces and TypeScript contracts to NestJS APIs, PostgreSQL, AWS, testing, and deployment. This is a hands\-on engineering role where you'll own features from architecture and implementation through to production.*

*You'll work closely with the Product and Engineering teams to turn evolving ideas into reliable, production\-ready systems. You'll have significant ownership in how we build, test, deploy, and scale the platform, while also contributing to the development of Valerie's AI Agents and Brands \& Investment Growth Platform.*

**You could be a great fit if...**


You enjoy working across the full stack rather than being limited to frontend or backend.

* You like taking a feature from an idea or requirement all the way through to production.
* You are comfortable making architecture and technical decisions independently in a fast\-moving environment.
* You care about building production\-ready systems, not just getting code to work.
* You have strong TypeScript fundamentals and enjoy working with both React and Node.js.
* You naturally think about scalability, security, performance, and maintainability when building features.
* You enjoy solving complex problems across the browser, API, database, and infrastructure layers.
* You take ownership when something breaks and are comfortable digging into logs, metrics, and production evidence to find the root cause.
* You enjoy improving engineering workflows, code quality, testing, CI/CD, and development practices.
* You're excited by the opportunity to help build a product and technical foundation from an early stage.

**Requirements**

* 6\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with substantial ownership of production systems.
* 3\+ years of advanced TypeScript development across both frontend and backend.
* Strong understanding of TypeScript, including generics, discriminated unions, type narrowing, utility types, and strict compiler configuration.
* Advanced React experience, including component architecture, hooks, server state management, form performance, and reusable UI patterns.
* Experience building complex forms using React Hook Form or an equivalent library, with schema validation using Zod, Yup, or JSON Schema.
* Strong Node.js and NestJS experience, including dependency injection, modular architecture, validation, guards, interceptors, and exception handling.
* Strong understanding of REST API design, including resource modelling, pagination, filtering, versioning, idempotency, and consistent error handling.
* Strong PostgreSQL knowledge, including relational modelling, constraints, transactions, indexes, and query optimisation.
* Experience with Prisma ORM, including migrations and avoiding inefficient database query patterns.
* Experience securing web applications using JWT or OAuth 2\.0, RBAC, secure cookies, token rotation, and OWASP practices.
* Experience writing automated tests using Jest and browser\-level tests using Playwright.
* Production experience with Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
* Practical AWS experience across areas such as container deployment, managed databases, object storage, load balancing, IAM, configuration management, and observability.
* Strong Git skills and experience working through pull requests and technical code reviews.
* Ability to independently investigate and resolve issues across frontend, backend, database, and cloud infrastructure.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience with Nx or another JavaScript monorepo build system.
* Experience building multi\-tenant SaaS products and implementing tenant\-level data isolation.
* Experience with performance optimisation and observability for distributed applications.
* Experience working in a startup or 0 1 product environment.
* Experience building products involving AI agents, AI workflows, or LLM\-powered applications.
* Experience working closely with Product teams to turn ambiguous requirements into technical solutions.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Features are strongly typed from database and API contracts through to the React interface.
* Authentication, authorisation, and tenant boundaries are enforced securely at the server level.
* Database changes are supported by safe migrations, appropriate constraints, and thoughtful indexing.
* Critical business workflows have meaningful automated test coverage.
* Pull requests are clean, maintainable, and supported by clear technical reasoning.
* Production issues can be traced through structured logs, metrics, and reproducible evidence.
* Services can be deployed through automated, repeatable pipelines without manual configuration.
* You take ownership of what you build and continuously improve the reliability and quality of the platform.

**You probably shouldn't apply if...**

* You prefer working exclusively on either frontend or backend.
* You need detailed instructions before making technical decisions.
* You see engineering as simply writing code against predefined tickets.
* You're uncomfortable working in an environment where requirements and priorities evolve quickly.
* You don't enjoy debugging problems that span multiple layers of the technology stack.
* You prefer highly structured environments with established systems and processes.
* You aren't comfortable taking ownership of a feature after it has been deployed.

*The best time to join Valerie was yesterday. The next best time is now*

**Our Hiring Process**


We want interviews to be valuable for both sides. Throughout the process, you'll meet the people you'll work with, learn more about the role, and get a chance to understand how we think and operate.


Our process typically includes:

* Introductory conversation with our Talent team \<\> 30 mins
* Hiring Manager interview \<\> 30\-45 mins

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
* 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* 5 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.
* Experience developing accessible technologies.
* Understanding of billing systems, subscription lifecycle management, or financial transaction processing.

**About the job**
-----------------


Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.



The Cloud Ordering organization is directly responsible for Google Cloud’s ability to scale its business. We bring automation and reliability to the ordering process, creating a single entry point for different ordering experiences and service providers bringing new products to market. We directly impact customer satisfaction by reducing friction when creating new subscriptions, contracts, and commitments, all while improving the correctness of mapping customer expectations to their provisioned resources.


The Order Orchestration team is responsible for the asynchronous processes that fulfill the obligations of an order. The infrastructure is responsible for the "moving parts" of subscriptions and cloud commit contracts being executed efficiently and reliably, while providing a rich interface that let service teams across Google Cloud self\-serve integrate their entitlements to a broad range of purchase experiences.


Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Write and test product or system development code.  

Collaborate effectively with product managers, other engineering teams in Google Cloud Business Platform (GCBP), and support personnel to deliver integrated solutions.
* Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies. Actively learn and grow, building expertise in distributed systems, cloud billing architecture, and subscription management best practices.
* Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).
* Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.
* Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**The Hard Thing About Data** 




  





 Most companies that claim to have a "data platform" have a dashboard with some charts and a dream. Hevo has something different. Something that took eight years to build and can't be bought. Over 2,000 companies send us their most sensitive data every single day. 100 billion events a month. Raw. Unfiltered. Before transformation, before aggregation, at the exact moment truth is created. That's not a product feature. That's trust, earned one customer at a time, over eight years, by not screwing up.
 



 That position is now the foundation for something much bigger. We're building an Intelligence Layer on top of it, a system that reads across every data source a company runs, connects the signals that matter, and tells people what to do before they have to go looking for answers. We call it the Context Graph. It's real enough to show results. Early enough that the person who joins now defines what it becomes.
 



 This is the moment. Not the moment after it's obvious. Now.
 



  





**What You're Walking Into** 




  





 You'll own a product pod. SaaS integrations, database connectors, or the Intelligence Layer, depending on where the biggest need is when you join. You own the backlog. More importantly, you own the
 *why* 
 behind everything that gets built. You report directly to the CEO. In the first 3\-6 months, your job is to make the foundation bulletproof, find the gaps in the platform, close them, and make the product sharper than it's ever been. After that, you move into the Intelligence Layer and help define what Hevo becomes in its next chapter.
 



  





**What This Job Actually Is** 




  





 Let's be honest about what great PMs do, and what mediocre ones do instead. Mediocre PMs write specs and hand them off. They synthesize feedback from CSMs and call it customer insight. They sit in architecture meetings and nod. They measure their own output in documents shipped, not outcomes delivered. That's not this job. This job is three things, done well, simultneously.
 



  





**First: Technical ownership.** 
 You will be in the room when architecture decisions get made. Not watching. Contributing. Pushing back. Asking the questions that change the direction of the decision. You need to understand how data pipelines work at a systems level, CDC, connectors, streaming, schema management, failure modes. If you can't hold your own in that room, engineering will stop inviting you to it. And they'll be right to.
 



  





**Second: Direct customer engagement.** 
 You talk to customers yourself. No intermediary. No secondhand summary. You hear the problem in the customer's own words, you sit with the complexity of it, and you own the translation into product decisions. If you're relying on a CSM to tell you what customers need, you will always be one step behind.
 



  





**Third: Making complexity simple.** 
 Hevo's product is deeply technical. The people who sell it and support it are not always. A big part of your job is taking complex system behavior and making it crisp and understandable, for Support, for CS, for Solutions Engineering, so they can represent the product confidently to customers. If internal teams are confused, customers will be too.
 



  





**Who We're Looking For** 




  





 6\-8 years of product experience. Meaningful time on platform or infrastructure products at B2B companies. Not optional.
 



  





 Strong technical depth. CS degree or equivalent engineering background. You should be able to hold a real conversation about system design, data architecture, API design, and engineering tradeoffs, not a surface level one.
 



  





 Proven ability to engage directly with customers. Not customer research. Not user interviews handed to you by a researcher. Direct engagement, gathering requirements, presenting product direction, handling objections in real time.
 



  





 Clear, structured communication. Written and verbal. You can make a complex system understandable to a non\-technical audience without sacrificing accuracy. This is rarer than it sounds.
 



  





 High ownership. You don't wait for conditions to be perfect. You move. You iterate. You follow through. When you say you'll do something, it gets done.
 



  





 Nice to have: Engineer\-turned\-PM. Experience at a Series A\-C company where you had to balance speed with quality. Familiarity with the data integration and pipeline landscape.
 



  





**What Good Looks Like in Year One** 




  





 After 12 months, a great hire will have:
 



 Full, unambiguous ownership of their pod's backlog, with a defensible point of view on priorities that's grounded in customer reality and business impact.
 



 Identified and closed the most critical gaps in their product area, with improvements that customers and internal teams can actually feel.
 



 Built enough technical depth to shape architecture decisions, not observe them.
 



 Become the person in the company most connected to what customers actually need from their product area.
 



 Made internal teams measurably better at representing the product.
 



 Started actively shaping the Intelligence Layer, contributing product thinking and customer insight as Hevo moves into its next chapter.
 



  





**The Moment** 




  





 Hevo spent eight years building both a product and a business simultaneously, and the foundation is real.
 



  





 The Intelligence Layer is early. The window to define what it becomes is open right now. Most people will look at this moment in five years and wish they'd been here for it.
 



 If you're one of the people who wants to be here for it, let's talk.

**Product Manager – AppsForBharat** 




 📍

 🛠

**About AppsForBharat (Sri Mandir)** 




 AppsForBharat is a Series C funded faith\-tech startup backed by leading investors including Fundamentum, Susquehanna Asia VC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital), Elevation Capital, and BEENEXT. Our team draws talent from IITs, IIMs and other premier institutes, with deep experience scaling high\-growth consumer internet startups.
 



 Our flagship product, Sri Mandir, launched in November 2020, is the world's largest app for Hindu devotees — a digital sanctuary offering seamless access to sacred rituals, divine teachings, and a vibrant spiritual community. The app is growing 20–25% month\-on\-month, and we are now building
 **Sri Mandir Web** 
 to extend this experience to millions of devotees who discover and engage with us through the browser.
 



 The devotion market in India is a $44B opportunity growing at 10% CAGR, of which temples alone drive \~$27B in GMV. Web is a critical, largely untapped channel to capture this opportunity at scale through organic discovery, SEO, and frictionless devotee journeys.
 



  





**Product Role Overview** 




 As Product Manager for
 **Sri Mandir Web** 
 , you will own the end\-to\-end product lifecycle for building a fast, engaging, and trustworthy website that serves millions of devotees worldwide. This is a first\-principles, high\-ownership role, you will be expected to question existing assumptions, reimagine devotee journeys for the web (a fundamentally different medium from app), and build measurable, compounding growth loops around acquisition, engagement, and monetisation.
 



 You will be especially responsible for how devotees are acquired, including through SEO. Reimagine how devotees experience the site pre\- and post\-transaction in their journey, and turn a one\-time visitor into a returning, engaged devotee.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





***Product Vision \& Strategy***




 • Define and own the Sri Mandir Web Product roadmap, grounded in first\-principles thinking that works for Web audience.
 



 • Identify the highest\-leverage problems in the devotee journey by breaking them down to root causes, not surface symptoms.
 



 • Work with Website P\&L lead, to own the complete business flywheel and deliver retention and revenue outcomes
 



  





***Acquisition \& Organic Growth***




 • Own complete acquisition funnels with a strong focus on organic and SEO\-driven growth alongside paid and referral channels.
 



 • Partner closely with Analytics, CRM, Content, Marketing, Design and Engineering teams to define the site architecture that drives speed and enable discoverability at scale.
 



  





***Engagement \& User\-First Journeys***




 • Apply deep, empathetic, user\-first thinking to design web journeys that feel intuitive, trustworthy, and delightful for devotees
 



 • Design and continuously refine post\-transaction user flows, cross\-sell and re\-engagement journeys, that build habitual, repeat engagement
 



  





***Data\-Driven Decision Making***




 • Leverage analytics, cohort analysis, user research, and market insights to identify problems, size opportunities, and prioritise the roadmap.
 



 • Set up and track KPIs across the funnel, traffic, conversion, ARPU, retention, and repeat transactions
 



  





***Ownership \& Cross\-Functional Leadership***




 • Lead the product lifecycle from concept and requirements to launch and post\-launch optimisation.
 



 • Stay ahead of web/SEO trends, competitor moves, and emerging technologies to keep Sri Mandir Web at the frontier of devotional tech.
 



  





**What You Bring** 




 • Bachelors or Masters degree from Tier 1 premier institute — IIT, BITS Pilani, IIM, ISB preferred.
 



 • Experience: Minimum 2\+ years of B2C product management and growth experience, with measurable impact on Revenue, CRO LTV and Retention
 



 • First\-principles thinker: Demonstrated ability to solve ambiguous, complex problems from the ground up rather than relying on existing playbooks.
 



 • Web acquisition \& SEO: Product knowledge of SEO and organic acquisition levers (technical SEO, content strategy, site performance)
 



 Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex, funnel\-level datasets.
 



 • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
 



  





**Bonus Points** 




 • Past founding or entrepreneurial experience.
 



 • Hands\-on experience with SEO/organic growth as a primary growth lever in a previous role.
 



 • Experience managing products across Web platforms.
 



 • Past experience building and growing e\-commerce products.
 



  





**Why You'll Love It Here** 




 • Build India's next\-generation devotional web experience from the ground up, for millions of devotees worldwide.
 



 • True end\-to\-end ownership: idea, build, launch, scale.
 



 • Highly collaborative, autonomous work culture.
 



 • Competitive compensation and performance\-based incentives.
 



 • Health \& wellness benefits for you and your family.
 



 • A serene, pet\-friendly, peaceful office in the heart of HSR Layout, Bangalore.
 



  





 Let’s build something meaningful together. ✨
