jobs.description:
**About Sarvam**
 Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India’s full\-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India’s leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're building India's sovereign AI platform across API, Agents, Creator Studio, and consumer products. Acquisition is getting easier. Activation is where most of our users are dropping. We need a PM who owns the full top\-of\-funnel: how people find us, how they sign up, how they get to their first meaningful moment, and how we make sure they come back the next day.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of growth, product analytics, and lifecycle. You'll work closely with marketing, platform, and product teams to turn installs and signups into activated, engaged users who stick.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Signup, login, and onboarding. Own the charter of everything from the first touchpoint to an activated user, on app and off app. Design the onboarding flows. Cut steps. Pick the right activation moment per product and ship toward it.
* Activation funnels. Define what activation means for each product and instrument it end to end. Find the drop\-offs. Run experiments at every step. Move the curve.
* Marketing channels and attribution. Own the channel mix from a product standpoint. Work with marketing on paid, organic, referral, and partnerships. Build the attribution setup so we know what's actually working. Hold a clear view on CAC and channel quality.
* Quality of acquired users. Not all signups are equal. Define what a good user looks like, segment by source, and feed that back into acquisition. Kill channels that bring junk. Double down on the ones that bring repeat users.
* Virality and social loops. Build referral mechanics, social sharing, and in\-product virality where it fits. Find the wedge that turns one user into three.
* Lifecycle and re\-engagement. Ship in\-product nudges and off\-product touchpoints (email, WhatsApp, push) that get new users to the second session, the third session, the habit.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 5\+ years in product management with at least 2\-3 years owning growth, activation, or top\-of\-funnel at a startup or consumer/developer product
* You've moved an activation metric and can talk about it specifically: the baseline, what you shipped, what worked, what didn't
* Deep working knowledge of activation, engagement, and retention funnels. You understand each step, each cohort, and where the cliffs are
* Hands\-on with marketing channels and attribution. You've worked with paid, organic, referral, and lifecycle, and you know how to measure each
* You live in product analytics. Mixpanel, PostHog, Amplitude, whatever the stack is. You pull SQL when you need to. You don't wait for the data team
* You have an intuitive sense for what makes a product activate faster. Friction, time\-to\-value, the right first action. You see it without being told
* Numbers at your fingertips. CAC, activation rate, D1/D7/D30 retention, channel ROI, cohort curves. These live in your head
* Clear thinker on user quality. You don't celebrate signup numbers. You celebrate activated users who come back


**Bonus Points**
* Built referral programs or viral loops that materially moved acquisition
* Worked on developer products, AI products, or India\-first consumer products
* Background in mobile growth, including store optimization and install\-to\-activation funnels


**Why this role?**
* Real ownership. You own growth across the company. The signup page, the activation flow, the channel strategy, the referral program. Yours to shape.
* Move metrics at scale. Sarvam's products touch the entire Indian developer and consumer market. An onboarding change you ship on Monday shows up in activation dashboards by Friday. Few companies offer this kind of leverage this early.
* The best product team you'll work with. Sharp operators from the best product orgs in India. People who ship weekly, argue hard, and ship harder. You'll be pushed and you'll grow fast.
* AI at the frontier. You'll sit next to researchers building India's foundation models. Access to the latest cutting\-edge models, internal research, and a team that genuinely understands how this technology works. Not a wrapper company.
* Independence to bet big. If you have a thesis on a new acquisition channel, a virality mechanic, or an activation rebuild, bring it. We give PMs room to run their own experiments and own the outcomes, good or bad.
* The standard startup perks. Competitive cash, meaningful equity, top\-tier health insurance, great Bangalore office, a team that actually eats lunch together.


**Why Sarvam?**
 Sarvam is a fast\-moving, high talent\-density team building full\-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population\-scale impact.
   

  

* Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar
* High ownership and high impact, from day one
* Everything we do is AI\-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems
* You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates


 If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

**Location: Bangalore \| Full\-Time \| Experience: 3\-5 Years** 




  





**About Rekise Marine** 




 Rekise Marine is building autonomous ships and submarines that operate in the world's most hostile environments. We're executing India's flagship autonomous submarine project — the Jalkapi XLAUV — on order from the Indian Navy. This is an unmanned submarine weighing over 20 tons that can travel 5,000\+ kilometers autonomously and operate in the ocean for 30\+ days at a time.
 



 We're creating some of the largest autonomous robots in the world, machines with direct impact on the global economy and national security. While autonomous cars in India may still be a dream, autonomous ships and submarines are already a reality, and it is possible to build for the world from India.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We are looking for a Product Manager to own the Command \& Control (C2\) and GUI across Rekise's platforms — the system through which operators monitor, navigate, and command our autonomous vessels. The C2 product is an evolving, greenfield system, so you will help shape it from an early stage rather than inherit a mature product.
 



 This is a dual role spanning product ownership and technical program management, weighted towards product. You will work with a cross\-functional fully contained team of 5–10 for design, frontend, and backend engineering.
 



 In this role, you will:
 


* Own the C2 product end\-to\-end — requirements, specifications, user flows, and user experience.
* Run the technical program management for C2, supported and guided by our Program Management Office.
* Work closely with our design, engineering, robotics, and operations teams to turn complex operational needs into a clear, well defined and intuitive product.



 This is a rare opportunity to shape the system that commands real\-world autonomous platforms operating in some of the most challenging environments
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the product vision and roadmap for the C2 GUI system across Rekise’s platforms, ensuring a consistent and high\-quality user experience.
* Own the end\-to\-end design of the C2, including elements such as the user GUI, user workflows, role\-based access, and permission models.
* Define \& document product requirements (PRDs), specifications, user flows, and acceptance criteria, translating operational needs from the user into clear deliverables for the engineering team.
* Engage intended users through interviews/interactions, translating findings into product requirements and UX decisions.
* Direct \& guide the design and frontend teams — working closely with designers and the full\-stack engineering team to take features from concept to delivery.
* Drive UX and product decisions grounded in how operators actually monitor, navigate, and command autonomous vessels.
* Run the technical program management for C2 — planning, sequencing, tracking, and unblocking delivery — in close coordination with and under the guidance of the Program Management Office.
* Manage cross\-functional dependencies across product, design, engineering, robotics, and operations to keep the roadmap on schedule.
* Maintain clear visibility of progress, risks, and open points, and communicate status to leadership.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* 3–5 years of product management experience, preferably on GUI for products.
* Demonstrated ability to write clear PRDs, specifications, and user flows, and to think product problems through end\-to\-end
* Experience working closely with design and engineering teams to ship user\-facing software
* Strong grasp of UI/UX principles, with the ability to direct design without necessarily executing it hands\-on
* Experience with, or a strong understanding of, the design of user\-facing systems, including aspects such as user access and permissions
* Sufficient technical fluency to engage credibly with front\-end and software development teams
* Ability to run technical program management planning, tracking, and unblocking delivery across teams
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills



  





**Preferred Experience** 



* Background in deep\-tech, robotics, defence, maritime, or hardware\-software products.
* Exposure to real\-time systems, telemetry, or operator\-facing control interfaces.



  





**Why Join Rekise Marine** 



* **Own the System That Commands Autonomy:** 
 You will own the system through which operators command autonomous vessels across a range of applications,from our flagship Jalkapi XLAUV, a 20\-ton submarine travelling 5,000\+ kilometres underwater, to platforms operating from the coast to the deep sea. Few product roles let you shape something this consequential.
* **Mission Impact:** 
 The Command \& Control system is the command surface for autonomous vessels on live missions including defence and security operations of national importance. Every flow you define and every permission you design directly shapes how operators make decisions in the field.
* **End\-to\-End Ownership:** 
 You will own both the product and its delivery from requirements and UX through to program execution across Rekise’s platforms.
* **Cross\-Disciplinary Work:** 
 Work at the intersection of product, design, AI, robotics, and operations. Few product roles let you work this closely with the systems your product commands.
* **Growth:** 
 As we scale, your role grows from owning one product to shaping product practice across the organisation.
* **Benefits:** 
 Compensation benchmarked to top\-quartile for the role, health insurance for you and your family and other benefits.

 Headquartered in India, its flagship product, the PhonePe digital payments app, was launched in Aug 2016\. As of April 2025, PhonePe has over 60 Crore (600 Million) registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4 Crore (40\+ million) merchants. PhonePe also processes over 33 Crore (330\+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore.
   

  

 PhonePe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance, Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode \- hyperlocal e\-commerce and Indus AppStore Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India, which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.
   

  

**Culture:**
 At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe\-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
   

  

**Challenges**
 Building for Scale, Rapid Iterative Development and Customer\-centric Product Thinking at each step defines every day for a developer at PhonePe. Though we engineer for a 50million\+ strong user base, we code with every individual user in mind.  As the product manager solving growth focused problems, you will own and drive the vision and road map for products driving customer growth for both PhonePe and PhonePe’s merchant partners.  This role will require deep problem\-solving acumen as well as strong communication and negotiation skills. Most of all it will require a proven track record of shipping world\-class product solutions, preferably in consumer facing products.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Aerchain (Why Us?)
 



  





 We’re rewriting the rules of procurement with an AI\-first platform that powers $20B\+ in enterprise spend.
 



  





 From $4M ARR today to $25M ARR and beyond, our mission is to build enterprise\-grade, AI\-first procurement software for global enterprises across manufacturing, FMCG, and services.
 



  





 Role Snapshot
 



  





 You’ll own a cluster of modules and be accountable for the outcomes they drive across customers. You’ll work with enterprise clients to ensure they realise value from the product, lead solutioning for complex accounts, define what the cluster builds and why, and ensure every module delivers measurable customer value. You’ll work across business, engineering, and leadership, and develop the PMs / Builders in your cluster. You set the
 



 standard for how the cluster builds: solutions are prototyped in AI, and engineering builds forward from those prototypes rather than from a blank page. You report to the Product Lead.
 



  





 Role Snapshot
 



  





 You’ll own one or more modules end\-to\-end, not just the backlog, but the customer outcomes those modules drive. You’ll run customer engagements independently, work closely with business and engineering teams, and be the single point of authority for what gets built, deferred, and why. You don’t take requirements; you diagnose problems and prescribe solutions. You don’t just spec the build; you start it: you prototype the solution in AI, and engineering builds forward from what you’ve made rather than from a blank page. You report to a Principal PM / Lead Builder or a Senior PM / Senior Builder.
 



  





 What You’ll Drive
 



  





 Problem Discovery \& Research
 



  




* Own customer engagements end\-to\-end: understand their problems, workflows, and success criteria well enough to prescribe, not just specify.
* Analyse data and signals to validate and size problems. Know the problem better than the customer does.
* Zero escalations without a recommended path and supporting reasoning.



  





 Customer Ownership
 



  




* Own Tier B or Tier C customer engagements end\-to\-end, from understanding their problems to ensuring they realise value from the product.
* Solution customers independently, coordinating with other PMs / Builders where modules overlap.
* Be the single point of contact for your customers, not just during delivery, but through adoption and outcome validation.



  





 Solutioning \& Prototyping
 



  




* Define what gets built, deferred, and killed, with reasoning tied to customer outcomes, not stakeholder volume.
* Write PRDs that engineering can build from without constant clarification: scenarios, edge cases, and acceptance criteria all present before grooming.
* Build working prototypes in AI, not throwaway mockups. Your prototype is the foundation engineering builds forward from: developers extend the backend, harden it, and refine functionality from what you’ve already built. A large part of the build happens in your hands.
* Use AI across every step: research, problem framing, drafting, prototyping, validation.



  





 Execution \& Delivery
 



  




* Own sprint delivery for your modules. Coordinate across engineering and business teams. Unblock issues before they become delays.
* Ensure milestone testing and validation happens before release. Own the quality bar for your modules.



  





 Release \& Adoption
 



  




* Define and track customer\-value metrics for your modules, metrics that answer: is this module making procurement measurably better?
* Own post\-release adoption. A shipped feature with no adoption is a failure you own.



  





 You’ll thrive here if
 



  




* 4–6 years in product roles with demonstrated module or feature ownership.
* You diagnose problems from first principles and prescribe solutions; you don’t take requirements and execute.
* You use AI as a core part of how you work, not occasionally, but across every step of discovery, solutioning, and delivery, including building the prototype engineering carries forward.
* You make decisions in ambiguity with reasoning. You don’t escalate problems, you escalate recommendations.
* You think in outcomes, not outputs. You know the difference between shipping and delivering value.
* Bonus: exposure to enterprise SaaS, complex B2B environments, or procurement tech.



  





 What’s In It For You
 



  




* Full module ownership on a platform that processes $20B\+ in enterprise spend.
* Direct engagement with enterprise customers: you own their outcomes, not just their tickets.
* Work with a team that has chosen to move first on AI: you’ll be operating at a level most product teams won’t reach for years.
* A culture where problem solving, ownership, and action are rewarded, and the opposite is called out.



  





 Ready to build Aerchain’s future?
 



  





 If reimagining business engines with AI and solving problems at scale excites you, let’s talk. Apply now and help us build the most agile enterprise SaaS story in the world.

jobs.title: Product Manager-I/II
jobs.description:
About Lokal :
   

  

 In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier\-2/3 towns weren't really using
   

  

 the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they'd come
   

  

 back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and,
   

  

 eventually, something they used for almost everything online.
   

  

 This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place \& one app \- local updates, classifieds,
   

  

 jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight \- when one use case
   

  

 outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation
   

  

 of focused companies \& marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
   

  

 Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
   

  

 to connect Tier\-2/3\+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they've always deserved.
   

  

**We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:**
* Edutainment \& Skill Learning \- practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
* Matrimonial Matchmaking \- hyperlocal, compatibility\-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
* Agri Consulting \- farmer\-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
* Local Jobs \- blue\- and grey\-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
* Social \& Community \- Place to find \& post social updates (Lokal app)
* Emotional Well\-being \& Peer Support \- safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt \& Eaze)
* Astrology \& Guidance \- instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)


 Advisory Services \- early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more
   

  

**Requirements**
**Role Overview : We are hiring a Product Manager to lead key initiatives. You'll own high\-impact projects across pricing, growth, user retention, expansion, and platform strategy—working closely with cross\-functional teams to scale Products at Lokal.
   

  

 Responsibilities :**
* Drive product strategy to maximize conversion and retention through data\-driven analysis of supply\-side


**levers and their business impact.**
* Own and enhance payment systems by improving payment success metrics, optimizing payment gateway


**(PG) Integrations, And Elevating The Overall Checkout Experience.**
* Design and run pricing experiments including default pricing, cohort\-based pricing, discounting models,


**and repeat\-user strategies to optimize revenue growth.**
* Collaborate with Marketing to unlock and scale new acquisition channels while continuously optimizing


**performance.**
* Strengthen trust and user satisfaction by defining and improving profile verification workflows and


**customer support processes.**
* Partner cross\-functionally with design, engineering, analytics, and business teams to execute, measure,


**and iterate on impactful solutions.**
* Own the product roadmap, prioritizing initiatives based on business impact and user needs.
* Conduct market research to stay ahead of industry trends and incorporate insights into product strategy.
* Develop retention strategies to increase repeat revenue and long\-term user engagement.
* Analyze user behavior and implement gamification mechanics to enhance user motivation and platform

**SAP S/4HANA Senior Consultant**  

Inventory Management (IM) / Warehouse Management (WM)
  

  

**Role Overview**  

This role owns the physical and system truth of stock. Today inventory is split between the ERP and a legacy shop\-floor system, movements are tracked on paper and in Excel, hold and defective stock are segregated physically with manual approvals, and shelf\-life and re\-inspection cycles are administered outside the system. Your mandate is to bring all of it into standard S/4HANA IM and WM with batch\-level accuracy, real\-time synchronization to the shop\-floor execution layer, and the product\-specific packing and lot\-handling rules the business genuinely depends on. Lot splitting and merging, cavity\-level sub\-lots, FIFO picking, mixed\-lot restrictions and shelf\-life enforcement are core requirements, not edge cases.

at least 2 on S/4HANA (1909 or later).Deep IM configuration expertise: movement types, special stocks, stock\-status handling, transfer postings, physical inventory and goods\-movement design.Deep WM configuration expertise (or EWM with clear WM equivalency): storage structure, putaway and picking strategies, transfer requirements and orders.Demonstrable FIFO picking, shelf\-life management and batch\-determination delivery in a live production environment.Packing and shipping design with product\-specific packing rules and handling\-unit management.Mobile/RF and hand\-held terminal transactions, barcode/QR scanning and label printing; integration of S/4HANA inventory with an MES or shop\-floor execution layer.Ability to run fit/gap workshops with warehouse and production supervisors and produce auditable functional specifications and test scripts. **Preferred Qualifications** Bilingual English/Japanese (business level); prior delivery in Japan or with Japanese manufacturing clients.SAP EWM in addition to WM, with the judgment to advise on WM\-versus\-EWM positioning.SAP Digital Manufacturing inventory and component\-consumption integration experience.Experience replacing a legacy shop\-floor inventory or WIP\-tracking system…

At Fujitsu, our purpose is to make the world more sustainable by building trust in society through innovation. Founded in Japan in 1935, Fujitsu has been a pioneer in technology and innovation for decades. Today, as a world\-leading digital transformation partner, we are committed to transforming business and society in the digital age.


With approximately 130,000 employees across over 50 countries, Fujitsu offers a broad range of products, services, and solutions. We collaborate with our customers to co\-create solutions that drive enterprise\-wide digitalization while actively working to address social issues and contribute to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).  



Design, build, and support SAP ABAP and Fiori enhancements, reports, interfaces, forms, and applications aligned to business requirements.
  

**Role Overview**  

A technical role delivered under a strict clean\-core mandate. The program has deliberately constrained its build: 79% of requirements are met by standard configuration, and the WRICEF objects will be gated behind conditions precedent — a validated requirement, a quantified benefit, and confirmation that no standard alternative exists — and extensions are delivered on SAP BTP rather than by modifying the core. This role needs judgment as well as skill: the largest technical risk on the program is over\-customization, specifically rebuilding a legacy shop\-floor system's bespoke lot\-numbering and lot\-handling logic one\-for\-one inside SAP. You will be expected to resist that.
  

**Key Responsibilities** Translate functional specifications from all workstreams into technical designs, honest estimates and clean\-core\-compliant build approaches; challenge designs better solved by configuration.Develop the report backlog using CDS views, RAP services and analytical Fiori applications in preference to classical ABAP list reports.Develop enhancements using released extension points — BAdIs, key\-user and developer extensibility — rather than core modifications or implicit enhancements.Design and build interfaces between S/4HANA, SAP Digital Manufacturing, factory\-automation and edge systems and the analytics layer, using SAP BTP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration, API Management, Event Mesh) plus IDoc, OData, REST and file patterns.Build custom and extended Fiori applications with SAPUI5 / Fiori Elements, including shop\-floor UIs usable on hand\-held devices and gloved hands, with Japanese and English language support.Build the traveler / batch\-card print program and forms carrying resolved machine, tool, hardness, mold, cavity and lot detail; implement quality, hold and disposition approval workflows; build the flexible master\-data maintenance application if it clears its gate.Build the composite KPI CDS layer and the post\-Material\-Ledger allocation engine in the agreed architecture; enforce clean\-core governance — extension registry, released\-API discipline, upgrade\-safety review, code review — and document objects so client IT can maintain them. **BATCH MANAGEMENT \& TRACEABILITY EXPERIENCE — REQUIRED**  

Hands\-on Batch Management and end\-to\-end traceability experience is a mandatory requirement for this role. Batch, lot and cavity\-level traceability sits at the center of this program; candidates without demonstrable hands\-on experience in the following will not be shortlisted:Batch and classification data structures in S/4HANA — batch master, characteristics and classification, batch determination and status — and how to read, extend and report on them without breaking standard behavior.Batch number assignment: standard internal/external number ranges, the batch number BAdI, and the judgment to say honestly when a bespoke lot\-number format genuinely cannot be met by standard next\-number maintenance. **Join our India Tech Hub – Be among the first hires!**

Join us as we continue to lead in loyalty, delivering innovative customer experiences for some of the world’s most recognized brands while working alongside some of the best and brightest in loyalty.
   

  

**About The Team And What We’ll Build Together**
 The Product Owner team makes Kobie's strategic product vision a reality through the development of technology solutions. We drive projects forward, collaborating with development teams and stakeholders to deliver unparalleled personalized experiences to customers worldwide. We are quick on our feet, using critical thinking and creative problem solving to optimize the value of products released. We understand the importance of time for life outside of work \- recognizing public holidays,offering flexible time off, and prioritizing work\-life balance.
   

  

 As we expand into India, our new teammates will be fully integrated with our U.S. teams, working on global projects and gaining exposure to top industry leaders. With continued growth, we will establish a physical office in Bengaluru, India, giving teammates aspace for collaboration and fostering connection.

ZEISS in India is headquartered in Bengaluru and present in the fields of Industrial Quality Solutions, Research Microscopy Solutions, Medical Technology, Vision Care and Sports \& Cine Optics.


ZEISS India has 3 production facilities, R\&D center, Global IT services and about 40 Sales \& Service offices in almost all Tier I and Tier II cities in India. With 2200\+ employees and continued investments over 25 years in India, ZEISS’ success story in India is continuing at a rapid pace.

The Control Tower Operations Analyst is responsible for end\-to\-end supply chain visibility, order health management, and fulfilment performance across ZEISS India. jobs.description:
**Data Analyst, Operational Intelligence**
------------------------------------------


Location: Bangalore, India (Hybrid)


Team: Operational Intelligence


Company: Quickbase


### **Overview**


Quickbase is seeking a Data Analyst, Operational Intelligence to support our Sales and Product\-Led Growth analytics needs, with a particular focus on our Pave product. This role is part of our centralized Operational Intelligence team, working in close partnership with Data Engineering and Revenue Operations counterparts to ensure GTM teams have reliable, trusted data at their fingertips.


You will serve as an analytics partner for our Sales organization while also developing visibility into PLG signals, surfacing how product usage translates into trial conversion, expansion, and growth opportunities. The ideal candidate is a strong SQL practitioner who brings genuine curiosity about the business, thrives in a collaborative cross\-functional environment, and has experience supporting operational teams and recurring business cadences in a globally distributed setting.


### **What You'll Do**


* Develop and maintain reports and dashboards that track core Sales and PLG KPIs, including trial conversion, product adoption, feature activation, and revenue performance


* Serve as the Operational Intelligence team's analytics partner for Sales and Revenue Operations, translating business questions into reliable, actionable reporting

* Contribute to our central governed data layer by authoring and submitting dbt pull requests that extend our enterprise data models for GTM use cases


* Collaborate closely with Data Engineering to align on modeling standards, data quality practices, and pipeline dependencies

### **What You Bring**


* 3 to 7 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or GTM/sales analytics roles

* Strong communication skills, able to present data clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences

Pave represents an exciting new growth motion for Quickbase, and this role is critical to making that motion data\-driven from day one. As part of a centralized Operational Intelligence team, you will be positioned at the heart of how data flows from engineering to business decision\-making, connecting product usage signals with sales performance and revenue outcomes to help our GTM teams act faster and more confidently.


### **What Success Looks Like**


* Sales and Revenue Operations teams have reliable, consistent visibility into trial conversion, PLG signals, and expansion opportunities


* PLG signals from Pave are systematically tracked and surfaced to inform Sales prioritization


* Key GTM metrics are clearly defined, documented, and trusted across the organization


* Operating mechanisms including GTM business reviews and reporting cadences are consistently supported with accurate, timely data


* Self\-service reporting adoption grows within Sales and Revenue Operations teams


* Contributions to the central dbt model are well\-tested, documented, and aligned with enterprise standards


* Strong working relationships are established with Data Engineering and Revenue Operations counterparts

At Quickbase, we view AI as a tool to accelerate how work gets done — not replace it. We encourage thoughtful use of AI to improve speed, quality, and decision\-making, while maintaining strong judgment, accountability, and data integrity.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**Our Team** 




  





**PharmEasy** 




 PharmEasy was founded in 2015 with the sole purpose to make healthcare more available, accessible and affordable to all through the extensive use of new\-age cutting\-edge technology. Today, we are one of India's largest healthcare aggregators connecting millions of consumers to licensed pharmacies \& diagnostic centres online for all their medical needs. We are particularly catering to the chronic\-care segment, and offer a range of services including medicine delivery, tele\-consultation, sample collection for diagnostic tests as well as subscription\-based services for all these categories.
 



 Our highly efficient and technology led Consumer and Supply\-chain platforms ensure that medicines are delivered from a licensed pharmacy within six hours of the validation of prescriptions submitted by our customers. And such customer promises are improving with the increasing scale of our business, and continuous product innovation.
 



 By extensively leveraging the latest in hardware and software technology, we are also committed to eradicate fake medicines from the Pharma ecosystem that contribute to roughly 30% of drug volumes in India. Our product innovations have allowed for complete data transparency in the entire Pharma supply\-chain to empower even the end\-users to validate the authenticity and genuineness of the medicines for every medicine sold, using constructs such as unique barcoding of information like expiry dates, origination of drugs etc.
 



 With our scalable technology and processes, we are now reliably delivering healthcare services and medicines to almost every pin code in the country.
 



  





**Analytics @ Pharmeasy:** 




 The analytics team at PharmEasy is a centralized team helping the organization in problem solving and making data\-driven decisions using a wide variety of datasets, tools and techniques
 



 Being a data first organization, the team contributes vigorously across all facets of analytics from data enrichment and modelling, from descriptive dashboarding to investigative RCAs and insight generation, from building predictive/prescriptive algorithms to integrating these into product to create real business impact.
 



 Team members also gather a good amount of soft skill exposure working closely with key business owners, decision makers and product leaders that leads to building a well rounded experience in problem solving within a new\-age tech set up. Over the years, team members also get to work across a variety of business areas and product lines providing deep insight into healthcare ecosystem of the country
 



  





**Responsibilities :** 




 A Senior Business Analyst would be responsible for working closely with the Business Teams and helping them in making data driven decisions. This would require cross\-communication between the Business Team, Product Team \& Data Engineering as well. Apart from solving the business problem at hand, a Senior Business Analyst would also be responsible for sharing insights and learning basis the data exploration/mining and convert these into clear action points and ensure that the same are being worked upon. The Senior Business Analyst would also be responsible to mentor the junior analysts within the team
 



  




* Getting business requirements from the respective Business Teams, identifying the
* underlying business case and building a generalized solution
* Extracting \& Exploring the data from database and other sources that may exist,
* cleaning the data for any issues/missing values also needs to be owned upon
* Converting the cleaned data into actionable insights and sharing the same with relevant
* Audience
* Automation of data problems/solutions that occur recursively
* Flagging to Data Engineering in case of data sanity issues are to be seen
* Ensure that the action insights shared with the business teams are worked upon
* Ensure new business requirements are thoroughly vetted and signed off
* Knowledge sharing within the team and outside if required



  





**What are we looking for ?** 



* 3 to 5 years of work experience in the relevant field, preferably in a consumer facing company
* Proficient in SQL and/or HQL , ability to handle complex/inner queries
* Hands\-on with Google Sheets / Microsoft Excel (basic data cleaning, pivoting and data exploration)
* Must have worked on any one Data Visualization Tool (Tableau, Power BI, Microstrategy, Metabase etc)
* Basic automation skills using Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel are expected
* Hands on Knowledge of Python programming and Python for Data Analytics
* Hands on Knowledge on Machine Learning and Data Science Algorithms
* Communication skills to get the business requirements and give out the final insights
* Data Inquisitiveness
* Prior experience of mentoring / onboarding other junior analysts is a plus
